buckets.name: jupiter_main
buckets.documented: 0.5 RPS / 30 RPM keyless, per organisation, 60s sliding window. Shared across Swap, Price and Token APIs.

buckets.name: jupiter_execute
buckets.documented: Separate bucket. Keyless 20 RPS. Costs 0 credits.

buckets.name: dexscreener_300
buckets.documented: 300 req/min for pairs, search and token-pairs endpoints.

buckets.name: dexscreener_60
buckets.documented: 60 req/min for token-profiles and token-boosts endpoints.

buckets.name: solana_public_rpc
buckets.documented: Solana Labs public RPC: 100 req/10s per IP, 40 req/10s per method, 40 concurrent connections.

buckets.name: helius_rpc
buckets.documented: Free plan 10 req/s RPC, 1M credits/month. sendTransaction capped at 1/s on free.

buckets.name: helius_das
buckets.documented: DAS and Enhanced APIs 2 req/s on free plan; DAS methods cost 10 credits each.

buckets.name: goplus
